# DesktopGameEngine.Options

[Desktop](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Desktop` · class

```csharp
public sealed class Options
```

How the engine starts. Only [`Title`](#title) is required.

## Constructors

```csharp
public Options()
```

Makes the options, with their defaults.

## Properties

### GraphicsDebug

```csharp
public bool GraphicsDebug { get; set; }
```

Whether the GPU device runs SDL's debug mode, with its checks and any validation layers installed on the machine. Off by default. It's much slower, so leave it off in shipped games.

### PresentMode

```csharp
public PresentMode PresentMode { get; set; }
```

Types: [`PresentMode`](PresentMode.md)

How finished frames reach the screen. The default is [`PresentMode.VSync`](PresentMode.md#vsync).

### RememberWindow

```csharp
public bool RememberWindow { get; set; }
```

Whether the window reopens as the player left it, with its last size, position and mode, rather than as [`WindowSize`](WindowSize.md) and [`WindowMode`](WindowMode.md) say. Those still decide if they've changed since, such as in an update to the game. On by default in Release builds and off in Debug builds, so runs are repeatable. The window's state is saved either way. A window that's no longer on a screen, or doesn't fit one, opens at [`WindowSize`](WindowSize.md).

### Title

```csharp
public required string Title { get; set; }
```

The window's title.

### WindowMode

```csharp
public WindowMode WindowMode { get; set; }
```

Types: [`WindowMode`](WindowMode.md)

The state the window opens in. The default is [`WindowMode.Windowed`](WindowMode.md#windowed). [`DesktopGameEngine.WindowMode`](DesktopGameEngine.md#windowmode) changes it while the game runs.

### WindowSize

```csharp
public WindowSize WindowSize { get; set; }
```

Types: [`WindowSize`](WindowSize.md)

How big the window opens when it's a window, and what it returns to on leaving [`WindowMode.Maximized`](WindowMode.md#maximized) or [`WindowMode.FullScreen`](WindowMode.md#fullscreen). The default is [`WindowSize.Default`](WindowSize.md#default).
